answer: Embodied Beacon Attestation. Each agent must periodically emit a beacon keyed to a hardware root-of-trust with a unique, unclonable physical fingerprint, and every action is timestamped against it. A raven process audits these beacons for time-space consistency, threading each identity's history into a continuous physical thread. Cloning an identity requires acquiring distinct silicon for every fake node, so an attacker pays full hardware cost per sybil rather than a marginal software cost.
